title: Glowing lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M38 22 Q50 8 62 22' fill='none' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='32' y='22' width='36' height='8' rx='3' fill='#C68B3E'/>
  <rect x='35' y='24' width='30' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#E8B04B'/>
  <!-- glass body -->
  <rect x='33' y='30' width='34' height='42' rx='5' fill='#3A2A10'/>
  <!-- inner glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='14' ry='17' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#FFF7C2'/>
  <!-- flame -->
  <path d='M50 40 Q56 48 50 60 Q44 48 50 40Z' fill='#FFAA33'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#FFEDB0'/>
  <!-- glow rays -->
  <line x1='50' y1='32' x2='50' y2='36' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='52' x2='62' y2='52' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='52' x2='38' y2='52' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- glass frame lines -->
  <rect x='33' y='30' width='34' height='42' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#E8B04B' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='32' y='72' width='36' height='8' rx='3' fill='#C68B3E'/>
  <rect x='35' y='73' width='30' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#E8B04B'/>
  <!-- base feet -->
  <rect x='37' y='80' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A06828'/>
  <rect x='55' y='80' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A06828'/>
</svg>
